description: EXACT keyword / phrase search over the Ortexo Romanian legal database (codes, laws, Fiscal Code, OMFP accounting norms, and case law). Matches precise wording, ranked by how many of your words a passage holds and searched in full inside the principal codes — use it ONLY when you know the exact term, phrase, defined name (e.g. an account name), article number or figure. For a described concept or a natural-language question use search_semantic instead — lexical returns noise for prose. For court decisions set `sources` to ["jurisprudence"] (with both corpora the results are ranked together and may all be legislation): disputes, deductibility challenges or 'has a court ruled'. The two searches rank differently and find different passages: on 103 questions with a known answer (measured 2026-10-28), the answer was among the first 5 results of search_semantic for 67% of them, of search_lexical for 45%, of both for 41% and of at least one of the two for 71%.

full_text.description: Optional, with sources including "jurisprudence". true: the top 3 court decisions of the page come with a larger window (up to 3,500 characters around the best passage) and their dispozitiv (the operative part, or the last paragraphs when it cannot be delimited), in this one call. Billed as the search plus one decision read for each decision expanded.

relevance.description: Optional. true: each hit opens with its fit to the question, [potrivire: mare|medie|mică], measured on questions with known answers (a mare hit is the article asked for about half of the time, a mică one almost never). Given for search_semantic and for search_lexical over case law; hits with no measured band carry none and the page says so. No scores are given.

sources.description: Corpora to search. Defaults to ["legislation"]. For Romanian case law (court decisions) use ["jurisprudence"]: with both corpora the results are ranked together and may all be legislation.

name: search_lexical
